nodes.text: Last lesson in my pocket: *bronze*. Crag copper, crag tin, my furnace by the lane. Bring me one bar you made yourself and I'll believe all the rest.

choices.text: One bar of bronze. I'll make it.

nodes.text: Pick's on the counter if you need one. The crag is patient. The furnace isn't.
The crag keeps. Bronze has waited three thousand years for you already.
